title: Different rhythms meet a changing course

captions.energy: Seeking a combination of different needs

meaning: Practical combination of different actions through a similar motive is emotionally accompanied by the experience of events taking different turns.
text: Combining differences does not mean stopping change. Temperance in the physical position of this Energy Field describes shared actions where you combine different needs and ways of participating. In energy, the same Temperance motivates seeking that combination and allowing differences to influence a common decision. The Wheel of Fortune in emotions adds the experience of changing circumstances. The overall tone can be flexible: you practically accommodate different approaches and want to do so, while the emotional response still changes with the actual course of the shared situation.

For example, you combine one person’s wish for a walk with the other’s wish to sit and draw. Stops of different lengths enter the route, and you jointly seek a suitable proportion. Rain brings frustration, a shelter brings pleasure, and changing light restores interest. **We recognise different needs, while the day still takes turns of its own.** Emotional alternation does not prove the chosen combination mistaken or establish that you need to coincide in everything. The day remains a living situation rather than a fixed arrangement.

A difficulty arises if Temperance’s two roles become a demand always to find a calm midpoint. Frustration then seems a failure of accommodation, and every turn requires another compromise at any cost. The Wheel promises no even response, and repeated Temperance requires no doubled patience. Practical combination and a motive to recognise differences can remain while both people have different feelings and different readiness to continue under changed conditions.
